create_CSENet_human: create a CSENet instance with ishuman=True to load the SMPL human mesh model for dense pose estimation
create_CSENet_animal: create a CSENet instance with ishuman=False to load the sheep animal mesh model for dense pose estimation
run_CSENet_forward: run the CSENet forward pass with an image tensor and mask tensor to extract dense pose features and part assignments
review_CSENet_initialization: review the CSENet class initialization to understand how DensePose config paths and model weights are selected based on ishuman flag
summarize_CSENet_forward: summarize the CSENet forward method which pads images, extracts backbone features, pools ROI features, and computes mesh vertex assignments via squared Euclidean distance
